Name: Expanded Clint
Author: XellorYT
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
This mod adds a lore-friendly, well-balanced way to craft a Prismatic Shard in Stardew Valley. The recipe isn’t simply handed to you — you must earn the town blacksmith’s trust to receive his grandfather’s secret blueprints.
[b]Heart Progression[/b]
Clint’s friendship unlocks new crafting knowledge as your bond grows:
[list]
[*][b]4 Hearts — Copper Bar:[/b] Learn to craft Copper Bars from Iron Bars (1 Iron Bars → 2 Copper Bar).[/*]
[*][b]6 Hearts — Iron Bar:[/b] Learn to craft Iron Bars from Gold Bars (1 Gold Bars → 1 Iron Bar).[/*]
[*][b]8 Hearts — Prismatic Shard:[/b] Clint sends you a letter containing his grandfather’s secret blueprints and a bonus Diamond. The next morning, your character recalls the knowledge, and the recipe is learned automatically with atmospheric notifications.[/*]
[/list][b]Prismatic Shard Recipe[/b]
Craft a Prismatic Shard from 10 of each precious gem: Emerald, Aquamarine, Ruby, Amethyst, Topaz, Jade, and Diamond.
[b]Other Features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Immersive Discovery:[/b] After reading Clint’s letter, the recipe is not unlocked immediately. Sleep until the next morning — when you wake up, your character recalls the knowledge,  recipe is automatically added to your crafting menu with atmospheric notifications.[/*]
[*][b]Localization:[/b] Fully localized in English and Russian.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[*]SpaceCore (for HUD notifications)[/*]
[*]Esca’s Modding Plugins (EMP) (for delayed triggers)[/*]
[/list][b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and all required mods.[/*]
[*]Download the mod archive.[/*]
[*]Extract the folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via
[code]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/code].[/*]
[/list][b]Credits[/b]
Huge thanks to the creators of Content Patcher, SpaceCore, and Esca’s Modding Plugins — and to the entire Stardew Valley modding community for the inspiration!
